actual_dose_expectation: Inherited dose is unchanged: dose_gain_mean 1.0, injected_rms_A_mean ~0.0299 A, requested_rms_A_mean ~0.0299 A, actual_max_step_rms_A ~0.0308 A, actual_cumulative_step_rms_A ~1.20 A over 40 active steps, no atom clipping and no cumulative clipping. Because the support shrinks from 20 slots to 3, the same per-step RMS budget is redistributed over fewer atoms, so per-slot displacement is expected to be larger while the total requested budget is matched to the parent before any larger-total comparison. Time schedule is constant, so the schedule acts on the normalized requested displacement; common positive reward coefficients would be cancelled by gradient normalization, so no amplitude claim is made from coefficient size alone. Near-zero gradient is not amplified into a full step, and smooth force reduction is allowed as the target is approached. Uncertainty factors are defined only by observed reliability, not by LLM text confidence.
derivative_path: Coordinate-only VJP through the actual current world-coordinate leaf nodes for the three tracked slots; no affinity-head gradient, no SMC, no per-step extra affinity inference, no logits or discrete transition-rate editing. Sensing is detached: the assignment pi and the element-matching cost are computed without gradient, and only the real model coordinate VJP of R is taken. Routing is single, so there is no per-mode VJP count, no refresh schedule and no switch memory to declare; mode_switches is expected 0.0. The teacher endpoint enters only through the same-forward predicted endpoint target for the predictive bridge; the current-state term does not require endpoint prediction. Model VJP is valid only for the current call and is not a derivative over all future stochastic generation. Element, charge and necessary bond information are read from the existing generation head; formal charge is not treated as partial charge, pKa or interaction free energy.
design_grounds: Analyst G000 binds the local22 support (slots 6,13,22; orientation triplet [22,6,13]; pocket sites A:VAL:116:N/O, A:VAL:66:CG2, A:VAL:116:CA) as a strictly local NC layout whose terminal N (slot 22) is an aromatic acceptor-type nitrogen, distinguishable at the same clock times from the local15 support (slots 4,14,15; triplet [15,4,14]; pocket A:VAL:53:CG1, A:MET:163:CE, A:HIS:160:CE1/NE2) whose terminal N (slot 15) is donor-type. The local22 ancestor coords cluster near z≈10-13 and local15 near z≈14-18 at the same current_clock_times [0.0,0.12,0.25,0.5], so the two supports are geometrically separable without mixing clocks. The only executable change is the mode_specs entry: replace the parent's 20-slot reference mode with the single local22 mode (atom_slots [6,13,22], orientation_triplets [[22,6,13]], the four listed pocket sites, region_id F_b011_s030__v3_NC_local22). All other program fields (clock_policy fixed, teacher_time 0.5, type_target predicted, window [0.1,0.5], dose, schedule, routing single, sensing detached, no SMC, no affinity-head gradient, coordinate_updates_only) are inherited unchanged from R15_V3_COMPATIBLE. The support union {6:[3,17,22],13:[0,22],22:[6,13]} stays local; no points are added, no teacher is swapped, and no element target substitutes for an unimplemented chemical role. The parent R15_V3_COMPATIBLE outcome (mean_all_pic50 7.7108, best_qualified_pic50 8.5901, n_qualified 48/50) and the R02_v3 endpoint-clock comparison (mean_all_pic50 7.6187, best_qualified_pic50 8.6994, n_qualified 48/50) are the matched baselines, not guarantees. Prior-campaign evidence that local identity formation did not equal affinity benefit (R03 terminal N geometry match 95.8% with best qualified pIC50 8.127753; R16_v2 formed N without a high-score tail) and that the same element-matching cost did not replicate on a 3-point N/C region (R16) or 4-point O region (R18) is why this is framed as a support/clock pairing test with formation, retention and terminal value as separate propositions.
falsifier: Falsified if, under matched dose and the same fixed clock, the local22 support shows no distinguishable terminal element layout or tracked NC joint fraction from the local15 support, or if the terminal N does not remain at the acceptor-type position, or if local22-guided terminal affinity/quality is not distinguishable from the matched local15 comparison and the parent R15_V3_COMPATIBLE outcome (mean_all_pic50 7.7108, best_qualified_pic50 8.5901, n_qualified 48/50). Also falsified if the local22 layout forms during the window but is lost in the unguided suffix (formation without retention), or if the observed change is attributable to dose/normalization cancellation rather than the support choice. Nonzero component VJP is activation only, not formation; zero clipping or constant dose during control is not retention evidence; similarity, role probability or loss improvement does not substitute for final quality.
operative_terms: Single local mode on slots 6,13,22 with orientation triplet [22,6,13] and pocket sites A:VAL:116:N (idx 178), A:VAL:116:O (idx 181), A:VAL:66:CG2 (idx 91), A:VAL:116:CA (idx 179). Clock policy fixed; observable predictive_bridge_to_learning_end; teacher actual_ancestor_at_learning_end at teacher_time 0.5; representation actual current world coordinates in A for the current state and same-forward teacher predicted endpoint coordinates in A for the teacher target; current and endpoint targets are not exchanged. Reward is the parent pointwise local term: R = -(1/K) sum_j delta^2 (sqrt(1+||z_h[pi_j]-q_j||^2/delta^2)-1) with K=3, delta=1.0 A, rho=0.66, per-atom step cap 0.15 A, cumulative RMS cap 6.0 A, window [0.1,0.5], 100 integration steps, expected_active_steps 10-49. Assignment pi is computed in the detached branch with assignment_element_cost 0.5; it changes only the matched geometric correspondence and does not differentiate logits or elements. charge_weight 0.0 and typed_weight 0.0, so no charge or typed channel contributes. Free degrees of freedom outside the direct constraint are retained; model VJP can have indirect influence beyond the direct support.
